name: Session and token flaws
signals: token valid after logout or password change
safe_tests: decode tokens locally without modifying them
compare expiry, revocation, and role claims with self-owned accounts
test invalidation after logout and password change
do not forge tokens against real accounts
confirm: revoked or unrelated session still performs a protected action
defect reproducible and attributable to the target
false_positives: client-only token storage without server impact
